blocks.title: Zaati huqooq
blocks.text: Terms of use ke andar zaati huqooq mein privacy ka haq, maloomat ka haq aur raza wapas lene ka haq shamil hain. Users ko yeh huqooq aur un ka istemal maloom hona chahiye.

Kitab kehti hai ke Pakistan ke Personal Data Protection Bill ke tehat users apna data dekh, durust ya hazf karwa sakte, jaan sakte ke pata aur phone number jaisi tafseel kaise istemal hoti hai, aur platform chhorte waqt apna account aur data mita sakte hain. Bill tajweez kardah qanoon hota hai, is liye is ki maujooda haisiyat jaanch leni chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: groups mein terms of use ka document parh kar user obligations, privacy and data use, limitation of liability aur termination ki shiqein dhoondein. Khulase mein kya hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: User ko kya karna aur kya nahi karna, kaunsa data jama hota aur kaise istemal aur share hota hai, provider kis cheez ka zimmedar nahi, account kab aur kaise band ho sakta hai, aur data mitane jaise huqooq kaise istemal hon.

items: Zaati huqooq: privacy, maloomat, raza wapas lena, apna data durust ya hazf karwana.
